new_candidates.date_enacted: City Council gave Ordinance No. 1805 its second reading and final passage on 2026-07-06; mayoral approval recorded 2026-07-07.
new_candidates.duration: Prohibits the permitting, construction, expansion, conversion, establishment, or operation of data centers through 2027-07-06; bars acceptance or approval of applications; stays pending applications; directs the Natural Resources Committee to review environmental, public health, and infrastructure impacts.
new_candidates.trigger: Study of environmental, public health, and infrastructure impacts of data center development; public comments raised water, environmental, and cost concerns.
new_candidates.current_status: Active as of 2026-07-31; one-year moratorium effective through 2027-07-06.

evidence.supports: Adopted text of Ordinance No. 1805 and recorded mayoral approval date
Official July 6 City Council agenda for second reading and final passage

new_candidates.notes: Westfield is a city acting through City Council ordinance and mayoral approval (unlike the Town Meeting bylaw plus Attorney General review process used by Massachusetts towns), so this instrument does not require AG review to take effect. The May and June 2026 procedural steps toward this ordinance (initial motion, committee positive report, referral to hearings, first reading) are process events, not separate enacted instruments, and are not treated as additional candidates here.
